guard: layer 3 seat custody: only a contained seat cgroup proves a seat gone, a populated cgroup refuses a release, and no custodian child starts outside a seat cgroup a reap or release already removed
why: Each cell runs in its own delegated scope; the distinct-uid cells need root with a created agent user, or a mapped user namespace.
COTAL_SEAT_CGROUP_REQUIRE=1 makes a skipped cell fail, so a mutation cannot survive on a host that skips its cell.
